title: Vindicators with Pillagers
description: every time a pillager spawns a vindicator will spawn with him...
body:
**This datapack is the result of a few hours of development!**
With no support from anywhere, I just struggled through coding it but it’s finally here!

![SHOT](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/809d265f21dd0a823459662ec618bfbdc23acdb0.png)

**Vindicator with Pillagers** is a simple yet powerful datapack that makes Pillager Outposts a bit tougher to conquer....


# 🛠️ HOW THIS DATAPACK WORKS:
Every time a Pillager spawns, a Vindicator will spawn nearby.

# 📢 NOTE:
Currently works on versions below 1.21, but I’m working on an update for 1.21.x =)




# 📦 How to use?

Go to `.minecraft/saves/<your world>/datapacks/`
paste or drag this Datapack in.

Now go test it ingame!
Is it working or not..
If you see any bug, plz report me..
